answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The bridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the dune until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the knoll of the next round.
